description: This file defines a REST controller for previewing catalog categories in a Shopizer-based Java application. It provides stub endpoints that simulate catalog service responses when the actual service is unavailable, primarily used for frontend preview or testing purposes.

classes.name: PreviewCatalogController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller providing preview endpoints for catalog categories, returning stub data when the catalog service is not running.

methods.name: listCategories
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list categories with pagination, returning a stub page of categories.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns a specific stub category by ID or a generic placeholder if not found.

methods.name: stubCategoriesFor
methods.description: Private helper method that provides a list of predefined stub categories for a given store ID.
